fieldValues.title: Do our stage trade-offs meet the definition?
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Each stage trade-off in model A (container 165f3a6e) against the three properties: two goods, coupled cost, context-dependent.

Pass (6):
- Make meaning, Explore ↔ commit to a statement: both goods; constraint is when meaning is fixed (committing closes exploring); a new domain explores, a mature one commits.
- Choose a response, Weigh options ↔ commit to one: passes, on time and attention; it is the same line-1 trade-off as Make meaning met at a later stage.
- Shape the work, Plan in full ↔ file and start: both goods; constraint is the filer's time against grounding; a bug files light, an epic task plans.
- Allocate, Hold until ready ↔ let it flow: both goods; constraint is capacity and work in progress; high-risk work holds, routine work flows.
- Review and land, Review each change ↔ merge on green: all three agents used it as their passing example; constraint is reviewer attention and lead time.
- Decide, Case by case ↔ a standing rule: both goods; constraint is the owner's attention; novel cases want judgement, recurring ones a rule.

Partial (1):
- Sense, Keep everything ↔ one current picture: both goods, but the cost is weak; an archive and a desk can coexist. The real constraint is attention: what is recorded must be read. Reframe as 'Capture everything ↔ attend to what matters'.

Fail (2):
- Build, Prepare the workspace ↔ ship the change: fails property 2. A fresh worktree and a pinned build cost little when the tool makes them; stale checkouts are a problem to fix (finding 9cd7e06c), not a pole. The stage's real trade-off is already recorded among its set-aside tensions: Compatibility ↔ clean cut (both goods; constraint is consumers' ability to absorb change; RFC-051/052 evidence).
- Learn and remember, Record what happened ↔ change the practice: fails property 2; recording does not cost changing, and we want both. The trade-off underneath is 'Keep the practice stable ↔ change it from each lesson': both goods (a stable practice can be learnt; a changing one improves), constraint is people's capacity to absorb a changed process, and overdoing change is SP-114 (the process re-founded instead of evolved).
fieldValues.tensions:
- Two of the nine failed and one was weak: the first pass named some pairs that only sound opposed.
- Make meaning and Choose a response carry the same trade-off; that is expected where both refine line 1, but it may mean the two stages are one at this resolution.
fieldValues.next_action: Applied 2026-10-25 (owner, vignette 30e37fb3): Sense reframed to Capture everything and attend to what matters, Build swapped to Compatibility and a clean cut, Learn and remember reframed to Keep the practice stable and change it from each lesson. Next: fill the four cases for Review and land.
